cause_quote: The new callback `budgetCompactionSummary(body, suffix, maxChars, qualityRetention)` passed below-minimum head cuts to a fitter that set `high = mid - 1` when their estimated token cost exceeded the budget.
user_saw: When a small-context session overflowed, compaction could report that required facts exceeded the summary budget even though those facts would fit after trimming optional prose.
summary: The fix skips summary candidates below the required-fact minimum so the fitter can trim optional prose and still cancel when the required facts genuinely exceed the token budget.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent, which finalized safeguard summaries once at the fixed 16,000-character cap. PR #139822 introduced foreground-token fitting with a callback that could return a dense head cut below the retention minimum. That cut could cost more tokens than a larger candidate that preserved the facts, causing the search to discard the viable candidate from the first implementation.
